title: 一间房两个名字  (Two Names, One Room)

segments.t: On Wednesday evening, as dusk settles over Chengdu, Manager Zhou steps out of his office holding both the tablet and Chen's paper ledger, his face pale. Listen first.
老陈……小晴……快告诉我今晚六号房空着。
没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
一到七号钥匙全拿走了，八号房刚刷了油漆。
完了！昨天我没戴眼镜，在平板上接了电话预订！
等等，让我把平板屏幕和纸本子放一起看。
让我猜猜，你把没有的房间答应给别人了？
周经理！七号房已经住人了，您又订了一位七号房客人！
而且他坐晚上八点的火车到——只剩四十分钟了！
早跟你说过，那个平板是个坑。
外面下着大雨，街上酒店全满了！我们怎么办？
等等——三楼楼梯上面是什么地方？
那间向阳的旧阁楼书房……快跟我来！
Now let's go through the scene slowly, line by line.
没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
'No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.' Married pair in two characters:
夫妻
joins 'husband' and 'wife' directly into one everyday noun for a couple.
完了！昨天我没戴眼镜，在平板上接了电话预订！
'Disaster! Yesterday without my glasses I took a phone booking on the tablet!' Dramatic cry
完了
literally says 'it's finished!', how Chinese speakers groan 'we're sunk!' or 'disaster!'.
等等，让我把平板屏幕和纸本子放一起看。
'Wait—let me look at the tablet screen and the paper ledger side by side.' Modern tech reuses plain shapes:
平板
literally means 'flat board', the everyday Mandarin word for a tablet computer.
周经理！七号房已经住人了，您又订了一位七号房客人！
'Manager Zhou! Room seven is already occupied, and you booked a second guest into room seven!' Compact two-character compound:
住人
puts 'live' before 'person' to say 'occupied' or 'has someone staying in it'.
而且他坐晚上八点的火车到——只剩四十分钟了！
'And he arrives on the eight o'clock evening train—only forty minutes left!' Useful countdown word:
剩
means 'remain' or 'be left over', giving Zhou 'only forty minutes left'.
早跟你说过，那个平板是个坑。
'Told you before, that tablet is a trap.' Adding
过
after 'say' marks life experience in the past—'I have told you before'.
外面下着大雨，街上酒店全满了！我们怎么办？
'It is pouring rain outside and every hotel on the street is full! What do we do?' Every learner needs
怎么办
literally 'how handle', the universal Mandarin question 'what do we do?'.
那间向阳的旧阁楼书房……快跟我来！
'That sunny old attic study... follow me, quickly!' Facing the sun gives
向阳
built from 'toward' plus 'sunlight', praising a bright, warm room. Now let's hear the whole conversation again from start to finish.
老陈……小晴……快告诉我今晚六号房空着。
没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
一到七号钥匙全拿走了，八号房刚刷了油漆。
完了！昨天我没戴眼镜，在平板上接了电话预订！
等等，让我把平板屏幕和纸本子放一起看。
让我猜猜，你把没有的房间答应给别人了？
周经理！七号房已经住人了，您又订了一位七号房客人！
而且他坐晚上八点的火车到——只剩四十分钟了！
早跟你说过，那个平板是个坑。
外面下着大雨，街上酒店全满了！我们怎么办？
等等——三楼楼梯上面是什么地方？
那间向阳的旧阁楼书房……快跟我来！
Two guests booked into Room 7, pouring rain outside, and only forty minutes before the eight o'clock arrival. Episode 2 is done; join us in Episode 3 to see if the attic study can save the night.
下次见！
